description: Installation of a flue and new louvre grill on rear elevation
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( 'Results of a 48-hour noise level survey carried out at the rear of the Karma Indian Restaurant at 159 Hanworth Road, Hounslow and a report on the noise control measures required to reduce the noise impact of the proposed new kitchen extract system'; 'Risk Assessment for Odour'; Mechanical system: 'Rectangular Duct Silencer Type RAAC 33' and 'Rectangular Duct Silencer Type RAAC 38' and 'Rectangular Duct Silencer Type RAAC 25' and 'Acoustic Panel Systems PAC 40 & PAC 30' (by Emtec Products Ltd.; Site plan and location plan; proposed ground floor layout (received 18 December 2019); and Existing elevations 2; Proposed elevations 2 (received on 19 March 2020) ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until a physical sample of the flue finished in a powdercoated colour to match (as close as possible) the exterior finish of the building at 159 Hanworth Road has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved detailed thereafter.

Condition : 4 - (a) The cumulative measured or calculated rating level of noise emitted from the mechanical services plant including heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC) to which the application refers, shall be 10dB(A) below the existing background noise level, at all times that the mechanical system etc operates. The measured or calculated noise levels shall be determined at the boundary of the nearest ground floor noise sensitive premises or 1 metre from the facade of the nearest first floor (or higher) noise sensitive premises, and in accordance to the latest British Standard 4142; An alternative position for assessment /measurement may be used to allow ease of access, this must be shown on a map and noise propagation calculations detailed to show how the design criteria is achieved.

(b) The plant shall be isolated on adequate proprietary anti-vibration mounts to prevent the structural transmission of vibration and regenerated noise within adjacent or adjoining premises, and these shall be so maintained thereafter.

(c) Following installation of any mechanical services plant including heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC) to which the application refers, a post completion noise assessment shall be submitted for approval to the local planning authority which demonstrates the actual measured rating level of plant operating under normal conditions. All measurements shall be made in accordance with the methodology of BS4142: 2014 (Methods for rating and assessing industrial and commercial sound) and/or its subsequent amendments. The post completion report shall be both completed and submitted to the local authority within 28 days of completion of the installation for approval, demonstrating compliance with this condition.
Condition : 5 - The carbon filters of the flue/extractor shall be replaced every 6-9 months.
